topic: Myth: you need a fully custom backend from day one
caption:
Myth: “We need a fully custom backend from day one.” 🛠️

Most MVPs launch faster and cheaper on proven building blocks: managed authentication, a hosted database, serverless functions and battle-tested APIs.

Go custom where it creates your edge, and when real scale demands it. Not before.

The goal of version one isn't perfect architecture. It's learning whether people want what you built.

Agree or disagree? Tell us in the comments. 👇
